propositions: The current per-extra matrix job configuration fans out into 6 separate cells (5 per-extra + 1 union), each holding a full job slot for checkout/setup/install, consuming 21 concurrent slots and causing queue delays in a 20-slot organization.

The isolation extra set (agents, eval, tracing, mcp, grounding) differs from _optional.EXTRAS (agents, eval, grounding, metrics, tracing), leaving metrics with no per-extra CI coverage and mcp validated only by boot check.

A single venv-loop job must replace the matrix fan-out, running 7 iterations (6 isolated extras + 1 union), each in a fresh venv with absolute-path interpreter calls, rc accumulator error tracking, and no activation stacking.
The loop must enforce strict venv hygiene: no source activate, absolute $v/bin paths for all invocations, per-venv pip upgrade, and 'rebar-mcp --help' only in the mcp iteration.
Snapshot check names in main-protection.snapshot.json must be updated to remove references to deleted per-extra and union job names to prevent rollback breakage.
Durable test guards must verify loop contains rc accumulator pattern (continue/exit), no activate, and every _optional.EXTRAS key is covered to prevent silent regressions.
